title: A message from the gym
instructions: Spor salonundan kısa bir sesli mesaj. Kısa ama değişen bilgilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Hello Mr Aydın, this is Fit Life gym.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Your personal training session is moved from Friday at six to Saturday at ten.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Your trainer will be Tom, not Lisa, because she is on holiday.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please call us if this time is a problem.
